package.description: Blend Spotify with game audio via per-app volume control.

en-US.description: Blend Spotify with game audio via per-app volume control.
en-US.longDescription:
A Windows desktop app that dynamically blends your Spotify music with game
audio, giving the impression your playlist is part of the game. Balance music
against game sound (or a Discord call) with a single slider, and control it
with hotkeys from inside any fullscreen game.
en-US.name: AudioMixer
